business_problem: Intuit needed more performance, lower cost, and better operational visibility for an Automated Compliance Platform that evaluates millions of cloud and non-cloud compliance results every day.
solution_summary: Intuit migrated its Automated Compliance Platform (ACP) to MongoDB Atlas during an internal engineering sprint and had the system in production within a week by redirecting existing data streams to the new cluster endpoint. Atlas became the operational store for millions of daily evaluation results and immediately added real-time monitoring, lower infrastructure overhead, and easier scaling for the compliance workload. Intuit paired Atlas with MongoDB Charts and the BI Connector so compliance engineers and subject-matter experts could visualize database, CPU, memory, and disk behavior and feed preferred BI tools such as QlikSense from the same data set. That architecture sped up index operations, shortened audit preparation, and let ACP expose continuous compliance evidence across public cloud and non-cloud resources without the performance and IO cost profile of the previous system.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores ACP compliance evaluations and provides the managed database platform, performance monitoring, and scaling foundation for the service.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Charts
solution_components.role: Visualizes compliance data and operational metrics for internal dashboards and troubleshooting.

solution_components.name: BI Connector
solution_components.role: Exposes MongoDB data to QlikSense and other business intelligence tools used by Intuit teams.

data_flow: Cloud and non-cloud compliance checks generate millions of evaluation results that are stored in MongoDB Atlas, Charts and BI Connector make the same data available to dashboards and BI tools, and compliance teams use those views to monitor controls and prepare audits.
business_outcome: Intuit doubled performance, cut IO-driven costs, reduced index jobs from two days to under an hour, and shrank audit preparation from months to eleven days while improving real-time visibility into compliance operations.
metrics: Intuit serves more than 100 million customers worldwide.

Intuit is exploring Atlas Triggers and Atlas GraphQL API for future enhancements, but they are not part of the current production design.
